title: System for automatic storage and withdrawal of objects, and object transfer device used in the system

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate comprising a carrier plate and a seal fastened to the carrier plate extending around it
A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping device in grip
Vacuum handling apparatus with suction plate and grip unit combined
features.quote: An object transfer device, comprising: a support structure within which housing areas ( 50 , 52 , 54 ) are provided for housing object containers ( 14 , 16 ); picking means connected to the support structure for transferring, in
features.note: The reference discloses an object transfer device with picking means for transferring objects, which is a type of handling apparatus, but it does not specify a 'suction plate' or a 'grip unit' as defined in the feature.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate

claims.note: This reference describes an object transfer device for storage and retrieval systems, not a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device.
This reference describes an object transfer device with a support structure and handling means, not a housing with a grip portion and an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
This reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
This reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet from a vacuum generating device.
This reference describes an object transfer device and system, not a grip unit with a sound-damping device in a grip portion.
This reference describes an object transfer device and system, not a grip unit with a grip portion lined with sound-damping material.
This reference describes an object transfer device and system, not a grip unit with a vacuum generating device in a housing portion.
This reference describes an object transfer device and system, not a grip unit with a sound-reducing device in a housing portion.
This reference describes an object transfer device and system, but does not mention a grip unit, grip portion, or first/second housing portions, nor an air outlet.
This reference describes an object transfer device and system, but does not mention a grip unit, air collection device, air collection screw, or exhaust air.
This reference describes an object transfer device and system, but does not mention a grip unit, grip portion, second housing portion, air baffles, or exhaust air.
This reference describes an object transfer device and system, but does not mention a grip unit, battery coupling point, electrical energy storage device, rechargeable battery, or air baffles.
This reference does not mention air baffles, exhaust air, or battery coupling points.
This reference describes an object transfer device and system, not a vacuum handling apparatus.
This reference does not describe a suction plate with a carrier plate and seal.
This reference does not describe a grip unit as defined in claim 1 of the subject invention.
The reference describes anchorage means for engaging containers, but does not disclose a grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device.

claims.quote: A device according to claim 8 , characterised in that the gripping means comprise a suction cup member ( 74 ).
claims.note: The reference discloses gripping means comprising a suction cup member, which implies a suction opening and the ability to generate a vacuum. However, it does not explicitly state that the grip unit has a suction opening fluidically connected to a suction chamber delimited by a suction plate to generate a vacuum.

overall.why: The reference describes an object transfer device for storage and retrieval, which is a very broad category, but it lacks any specific details about vacuum handling, suction plates, grip portions, or sound damping as described in the subject invention's features.
